project_context.tagline: Co-Pilot Bimbing PR & Parenting Kurikulum Merdeka Terlengkap
project_context.target_audience: Indonesian parents (Bunda/Ayah) guiding children in SD-SMP Kurikulum Merdeka
project_context.language: Indonesian (100%) - Use terms like Bunda, Ayah, Kakak, Adik.

colors.strategy: Warm & Reassuring Parenting (Organic & Earthy). Soft Emerald for trust/growth, Warm Amber for joy/energy, Clean Cream for a comforting baseline.
rules: CRITICAL: Replace default Vercel/Shadcn neutral colors with the tinted values above. Background must be the clean cream (#FFFBEB in light mode).
No generic blue or pure grey. Always use the tinted teal/cream palette.
Use Primary (Emerald #0F766E) for trust/core actions like 'Foto Soal', 'Bimbing PR'.
Use Secondary (Amber #F59E0B) for delightful/attention elements like 'Demo', 'Tips', or interactive toggles.
BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Include Manrope and DM Sans from Google Fonts in index.html.
Labels must be uppercase with wide spacing.

surfaces.cards: Solid background (white or cream), generous 16px to 24px border-radius (rounded-2xl/3xl), subtle 1px border (border-border), no harsh shadows. Soft ambient shadow for active/lifted cards (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(15,118,110,0.08)]).
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky top header and bottom navigation to maintain context while scrolling. (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b/t border-border). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
surfaces.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Rectangular with rounded-xl for secondary/grid buttons.

layout_spacing.max_width: max-w-md mx-auto relative min-h-screen bg-background shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards. Use gap-4 to gap-6 between layout elements.
layout_spacing.bento_grid: For the 'Kartu Panduan Bunda/Ayah', use a dense, single-column bento card sequence to step through the output logically.

motion_interactions.micro_interactions: All buttons must have hover:-translate-y-0.5, active:scale-95, and transition-transform duration-200.
motion_interactions.child_proof_lock: CRITICAL: The 'Kunci Jawaban' must be a swipe-to-unlock mechanism. Use framer-motion <motion.div drag='x'> constraint to create a slider. Parents must drag the knob to the right to reveal the answer, preventing kids from cheating.
motion_interactions.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion to stagger-fade list items and cards for a premium feel.

component_instructions.AppContainer: Wrap the entire app in a div with 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative'. The UI is strictly mobile-first.

elements: Top micro-banner (Dukungan Lomba) - scrolling text (Marquee) or small solid ribbon.
Main Header row: Logo (Text + Icon), 'Demo 60 Detik' (Amber Pill Button), and a Hamburger Menu (Shadcn Sheet).
Header.drawer_menu: Use a Shadcn Sheet for the Hamburger Menu to house: Pengaturan Kunci API, Kalkulator Penghematan Biaya Les (Modal), Rencana Bisnis, Simulasi Marah vs Sabar, Riwayat Bimbingan.

BottomNav.layout: Fixed bottom, glassmorphism, z-50, grid cols-3, max-w-md mx-auto.

elements: Large 'Ambil Foto Soal' action block (Emerald background, text-white, prominent Camera icon).
Or 'Pilih dari Galeri' secondary button (HTML5 <input type='file' accept='image/*'>).
Horizontal scrolling row (overflow-x-auto snap-x) showing 6 'Galeri Contoh Foto Soal' (use provided sample image URLs) so users can test immediately.

BundaAyahCard.layout: The AI Output Component. Appears after a photo is processed.
sections: 1. Konsep Kurikulum: Clean card, light Emerald tint.
2. Analogi Benda Dapur: Amber tinted card, playful kitchen icon.
3. Skrip Sokratik (3 Langkah): Stepper format guiding parents on what to ask.
4. Taktik Penjinak Emosi: Muted card, heart icon.
5. Kunci Jawaban (Child-Proof Lock): Blurred/Locked area. Swipe to reveal.
BundaAyahCard.actions: Bilah aksi berbagi di bawah kartu: WhatsApp (icon), Putar Suara (Web Speech API TTS), Cetak PDF (window.print).

LibraryTab.layout: Pustaka 50+ Topik Kurikulum Merdeka. Use Shadcn Accordions grouped by Fase A, B, C, D.

ChatTab.layout: Ruang Curhat Parenting. Simple chat UI interface (bubbles) mapped to Gemini AI.

CalculatorModal.layout: Shadcn Dialog/Modal. Kalkulator Penghematan Biaya Les. Input monthly tutoring cost -> Output savings. Use canvas-confetti on calculation.

icons.style: Duotone, size 24. Highly recommended for a friendly, premium aesthetic.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-photo-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over Amber (#F59E0B) is dark (#134E4A), text over Emerald (#0F766E) is white.
accessibility.tts: Integrate standard Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis) for the 'Putar Suara' text-to-speech button.

libraries_to_install: yarn add framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react sonner react-markdown remark-gfm canvas-confetti react-fast-marquee
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' SaaS outputs. Do NOT make this look like a standard Vercel app.
Embrace the mobile-first constraint: force the UI into a max-w-md centered container with a bottom navigation bar. It should feel like a native iOS/Android parenting app.
Do NOT use pure white background unless it is specifically inside a card. The body background MUST be the clean cream (--background).
Add transition-transform duration-200 to all interactive elements. Never apply 'transition-all' as it breaks transforms.
The 'Child-Proof Lock' MUST use framer-motion for the drag slider interaction. This is a core differentiator.
Never use placeholders for images. Map the sample_homework URLs provided into the horizontal scrolling gallery.
All UI text MUST be in Indonesian. Use warm familial terms (Bunda, Ayah, Kakak, Adik) in placeholder texts and empty states.
Implement the 'Bunda/Ayah Guide Cards' as an emotionally directed, structured view, not a raw Markdown dump.
